What is a Transaction ID in Easypaisa and JazzCash?

A Transaction ID is the unique reference number given to one payment. Easypaisa, JazzCash and banks create it when money is sent, and no two payments share the same one. That is why it is the most useful detail for checking whether a customer really paid you.

Transaction ID in simple words

Every time money moves, the wallet or bank gives that payment its own number. You may see it called Transaction ID, TID, Trx ID or reference number. It is different from the customer's phone number, account number or your order number. The sender and the receiver see the same payment, so the Transaction ID on the customer's receipt should also appear in your own history or statement for that payment.

Where to find the Transaction ID

  • Easypaisa: open the payment in your transaction history in the app. The receipt for that payment shows the Transaction ID. The confirmation SMS usually includes it too.
  • JazzCash: open the payment in the app's transaction history to see its receipt and ID. The confirmation SMS usually includes it, often labelled TID or Trx ID.
  • Bank transfer: look for the reference or transaction number on the transfer receipt, in your banking app's history, or in your account statement.
  • Customer's screenshot: it is printed on the payment receipt, near the amount, date and time.

Can you check a Transaction ID online?

There is no public website where you can type in someone else's Transaction ID and confirm their payment. The reliable check is your own record: open your Easypaisa or JazzCash app, or your bank statement, and look for a payment with the same Transaction ID and the same amount. If it is there, the money reached you. If it is not, the payment did not arrive, whatever the screenshot shows. If you think a payment went missing, contact your wallet or bank helpline with the Transaction ID from your account.

How sellers use the Transaction ID to confirm a payment

  1. Ask the customer for the payment screenshot and read the Transaction ID and amount on it.
  2. Find a payment in your own app or statement with the same Transaction ID.
  3. Check that the amount, date and time also match.
  4. Make sure the same Transaction ID has not already been used for another order.

If the Transaction ID is missing, cut off or does not match anything in your account, hold the order. Read how to spot a fake Easypaisa or JazzCash screenshot for more warning signs.

Transaction ID ka matlab hai payment ka apna shanakhti number (reference number). Easypaisa, JazzCash ya bank har payment ko alag number dete hain, aur do payments ka ek jaisa number nahi hota. Ye app ki transaction history, payment receipt aur aksar SMS mein milta hai, kabhi TID ya Trx ID ke naam se.
